prompt: Who was the building named after on South Forest Avenue, which was built around 1959-1964 and designed by the architect married to Olga Lazovic?
answer: The building was **ASU Gammage**, formally the **Grady Gammage Memorial Auditorium** at 1200 South Forest Avenue in Tempe, Arizona. It was named after **Dr. Grady Gammage**, the president of Arizona State University. Frank Lloyd Wright designed it; construction was completed in 1964, five years after his death.
